description: This file defines a REST API controller for importing various entities into a database, handling JSON file uploads, deserialization, and database insertion.

classes.name: ImportResponse
classes.description: Holds the result of the import operation, including errors and individual entity results.

classes.name: ImportEntityResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome of importing a specific entity type, including count and errors.

methods.name: ImportData
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to import data from a JSON file, deserializes the payload, and processes each entity.

methods.name: ImportEntity
methods.description: Determines the entity type and calls the appropriate import method for each entity.

methods.name: ImportAsync
methods.description: Deserializes a list of entities and adds them to the database context.

methods.name: GetRootExceptionMessage
methods.description: Recursively retrieves the innermost exception message.
